description: Mohamed Farook Abusally v. Attorney General Mohamed Farook Abusally v. Attorney General View More before Hon. K.K. Wickramasinghe, J
parties: Mohamed Farook Abusally v. Attorney General Mohamed Farook Abusally v. Attorney General View More
keywords: Criminal appeal – Trial in absentia – Conviction and sentence – Appeal lodged nearly one year later – Preliminary objection that appeal was out of time – Application concerning order under section 241(3) – Whether a right of appeal lies from such an order – De novo proceedings – Procedural finality and appellate jurisdiction.
legistation: Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979 – section 241(3) and provisions governing appeals from criminal convictions/orders, including section 331.
